description: Test whether the IFT56-binding surfaces of IFT46, IFT52 and IFT70 are conserved between Chlamydomonas and the C. elegans orthologs DYF-6, OSM-6 and DYF-1
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu, fisher_exact
PROV='/agent/jobs/45cdd2ff-33f4-48dd-aecb-f650c9ff40d6/provenance/'

B62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ls=B62.strip().split('\n');AAs=ls[0].split();MM={}
for r in ls[1:]:
    p=r.split()
    for b,v in zip(AAs,p[1:]): MM[(p[0],b)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return MM.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    tb=np.zeros((n+1,m+1,3),np.int8);Mm[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1):Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1)
    for j in range(1,m+1):Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    sr=np.zeros(m)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        a=s1[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1): sr[j-1]=sc(a,s2[j-1])
        c=np.vstack([Mm[i-1,:m],Ix[i-1,:m],Iy[i-1,:m]]);k=np.argmax(c,0);Mm[i,1:]=c[k,np.arange(m)]+sr;tb[i,1:,0]=k
        c=np.vstack([Mm[i-1,1:]+go,Ix[i-1,1:]+ge,Iy[i-1,1:]+go]);k=np.argmax(c,0);Ix[i,1:]=c[k,np.arange(m)];tb[i,1:,1]=k
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            cc=(Mm[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(cc));Iy[i,j]=cc[k];tb[i,j,2]=k
    i,j=n,m;s=int(np.argmax([Mm[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]]));mp=np.full(n,-1,int)
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0:s=2
        elif j==0:s=1
        if s==0: mp[i-1]=j-1;s=int(tb[i,j,0]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif s==1: s=int(tb[i,j,1]);i-=1
        else: s=int(tb[i,j,2]);j-=1
    return mp
def fasta(acc):
    return ''.join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:]).strip()

# ---- 8BD7 partner-side interface residues (residues of D/B/C contacting chain E) ----
cif=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/8BD7.cif",timeout=300).text.split('\n')
st=next(i for i,l in enumerate(cif) if l.startswith('_atom_site.'))
hdr=[];i=st
while cif[i].startswith('_atom_site.'): hdr.append(cif[i].strip().split('.')[1]); i+=1
rows=[]
while i<len(cif) and not cif[i].startswith('#'):
    p=cif[i].split()
    if len(p)==len(hdr): rows.append(p)
    i+=1
at=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=hdr)
for c in ['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']: at[c]=at[c].astype(float)
at['auth_seq_id']=at['auth_seq_id'].astype(int)
Esub=at[at.auth_asym_id=='E']
Etree=cKDTree(Esub[['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']].values)
PARTNERS={'IFT46':('D','A2T2X4','Q0G838','DYF-6'),'IFT52':('B','Q946G4','G5EDF6','OSM-6'),
          'IFT70':('C','A8ITN7','Q8I7G4','DYF-1')}
res={}
for nm,(ch,cracc,ceacc,cegene) in PARTNERS.items():
    P=at[at.auth_asym_id==ch]
    hits=Etree.query_ball_point(P[['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']].values,5.0)
    rr=sorted({int(P['auth_seq_id'].values[k]) for k,l in enumerate(hits) if l})
    res[nm]=rr
    print(f"{nm} (chain {ch}) residues contacting IFT56: {rr}")

# ---- conservation of those positions in the C. elegans ortholog ----
out=[];detail=[]
for nm,(ch,cracc,ceacc,cegene) in PARTNERS.items():
    cr=fasta(cracc); ce=fasta(ceacc)
    mp=nw(cr,ce)                      # cr index -> ce index
    modelled=sorted(at[at.auth_asym_id==ch]['auth_seq_id'].unique())
    iface=set(res[nm])
    rec=[]
    for pos in modelled:              # restrict background to the modelled part
        if pos-1>=len(cr): continue
        j=mp[pos-1]
        rec.append({'cr_pos':pos,'cr_aa':cr[pos-1],
                    'ce_pos':(j+1 if j>=0 else None),'ce_aa':(ce[j] if j>=0 else '-'),
                    'identical':(j>=0 and cr[pos-1]==ce[j]),
                    'blosum':(sc(cr[pos-1],ce[j]) if j>=0 else np.nan),
                    'interface':pos in iface,'partner':nm,'ce_gene':cegene})
    d=pd.DataFrame(rec); detail.append(d)
    a=d[d.interface]; b=d[~d.interface]
    u,pv=mannwhitneyu(a.blosum.dropna(),b.blosum.dropna()) if len(a)>2 else (np.nan,np.nan)
    ct=[[a.identical.sum(),(~a.identical).sum()],[b.identical.sum(),(~b.identical).sum()]]
    orr,pf=fisher_exact(ct)
    out.append({'partner':nm,'Cr_acc':cracc,'Ce_gene':cegene,'Ce_acc':ceacc,
                'global_identity_%':round(100*np.mean([cr[i]==ce[mp[i]] for i in range(len(cr)) if mp[i]>=0]),1),
                'n_iface':len(a),'iface_identity_%':round(100*a.identical.mean(),1),
                'n_bg_modelled':len(b),'bg_identity_%':round(100*b.identical.mean(),1),
                'iface_mean_blosum':round(a.blosum.mean(),2),'bg_mean_blosum':round(b.blosum.mean(),2),
                'fisher_OR':round(orr,2),'fisher_p':round(pf,4),'MWU_p':(round(pv,4) if pv==pv else None)})
S=pd.DataFrame(out)
print("\n=== Conservation of the IFT56-contacting residues of each partner, Chlamydomonas vs C. elegans ===")
print(S.to_string(index=False))
D=pd.concat(detail); D.to_csv(PROV+'partner_interface_conservation_residues.csv',index=False)
S.to_csv(PROV+'partner_interface_conservation_summary.csv',index=False)
print("\nResidue-level view of the interface positions:")
print(D[D.interface][['partner','ce_gene','cr_pos','cr_aa','ce_pos','ce_aa','identical','blosum']].to_string(index=False))

# ---- figure ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
ax=axes[0]
x=np.arange(len(S)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2,S['iface_identity_%'],w,color='#E45756',label='IFT56-contacting residues')
ax.bar(x+w/2,S['bg_identity_%'],w,color='#B0B7C3',label='other modelled residues')
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{r.partner}\n(Ce {r.Ce_gene})" for r in S.itertuples()])
ax.set_ylabel('% identical, Chlamydomonas vs C. elegans')
ax.set_title('The IFT56-binding surfaces of IFT46, IFT52 and IFT70\nare conserved in the C. elegans orthologs')
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
for i,r in enumerate(S.itertuples()):
    ax.text(i,max(r._7,r._9)+3,f"n={r.n_iface}\nFisher p={r.fisher_p}",ha='center',fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax=axes[1]
bp=[D[(D.partner==p)&D.interface].blosum.dropna() for p in S.partner]+[D[~D.interface].blosum.dropna()]
ax.boxplot(bp,labels=list(S.partner)+['all background'],showmeans=True)
ax.axhline(0,ls='--',c='grey',lw=.8)
ax.set_ylabel('BLOSUM62 score, Cr residue vs aligned Ce residue')
ax.set_title('Interface positions score above background substitution')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
